brief: Patient Play screen (left) and therapist dashboard tiles (right) in one view. Compare fonts, colors and controls.

candidates.name: Soft Bento
candidates.concept: The Dribbble health-app look done well: pastel tiles in a bento grid, one confident violet, big friendly numbers.
candidates.typography: Plus Jakarta Sans 700 display, Plus Jakarta Sans 500 body
traits: Bento tiles in mint and peach

candidates.name: Ink & Lime
candidates.concept: A sports-tracker energy for recovery: near-black ink, one electric lime, chunky grotesque numbers that feel like a scoreboard.
traits: Lime only on the live pad

candidates.name: Warm Care
candidates.concept: Human and hopeful, like a good clinic brochure: a soft serif for headlines, cream paper, deep green and a terracotta glow.

candidates.name: Clear Sight
candidates.concept: Built for older eyes first: a typeface made for low vision, sky-calm blues, big targets and very clear states.

candidates.name: Ghar Friendly
candidates.concept: Warm and playful for an Indian home: rounded Baloo letters that also write Hindi, coral and teal, toy-like soft pads.
